skill.name: opentui
skill.description: Comprehensive OpenTUI guidance for building terminal user interfaces with the core API, React reconciler, and Solid reconciler.
skill.summary: Build OpenTUI terminal interfaces with framework guidance, component references, layouts, keyboard handling, animation, and tests.
skill.author: msmps

security_audit.summary: All static findings were adjudicated as documentation false positives from Markdown references and example code. Relative links, template literals, example URLs, .env guidance, keyboard handling, and debug logging examples do not execute inside the skill or request secret exfiltration. No prompt injection attempt or malicious intent was found.

content.value_statement: OpenTUI projects need framework-specific setup, component patterns, and terminal behavior details. This skill gives targeted references for core, React, and Solid TUI development.
actual_capabilities: Guides framework selection between core OpenTUI, React, and Solid.
Provides setup guidance for Bun, create-tui, TypeScript, and bundling.
Explains text, container, input, table, code, diff, and markdown components.
Covers layout, focus, keyboard shortcuts, paste handling, and clipboard behavior.
Documents animation timelines, easing, transitions, and looping patterns.
Includes testing guidance for snapshots, simulated input, and renderer cleanup.
limitations: It provides documentation guidance, not a runtime OpenTUI generator.
Generated code still needs local dependency installation and project testing.
OpenTUI APIs may change, so confirm versions before large migrations.
It does not replace accessibility, security, or performance review for production TUIs.

use_cases.title: Start a New TUI App
use_cases.description: Choose the OpenTUI framework path and generate a setup plan for Bun, TypeScript, and project structure.

use_cases.title: Port React Patterns to Terminal UI
use_cases.description: Map familiar React component patterns to OpenTUI components, layout, text styling, and keyboard hooks.

use_cases.title: Test Interactive Terminal Screens
use_cases.description: Design snapshot and interaction tests that simulate key events and clean up renderers reliably.

prompt_templates.title: Choose a Framework
prompt_templates.prompt: I want to build an OpenTUI app. Compare core, React, and Solid for my use case, then recommend one path.

prompt_templates.title: Set Up a Project
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a setup checklist for a new OpenTUI React app using Bun, TypeScript, and create-tui. Include common gotchas.

prompt_templates.title: Design an Interactive Screen
prompt_templates.prompt: Help me design an OpenTUI screen with a sidebar, scrollable content, text input, keyboard shortcuts, and focus handling.

prompt_templates.title: Review and Test a TUI
prompt_templates.prompt: Review my OpenTUI component design for layout bugs, keyboard conflicts, cleanup problems, and missing snapshot or interaction tests.

output_examples.input: I need a terminal dashboard with filters and keyboard shortcuts.
output_examples.output: A framework recommendation, component map, focus model, shortcut list, and testing checklist for the dashboard.

output_examples.input: My OpenTUI text styles do not render in React.
output_examples.output: A troubleshooting path that checks modifier elements, nested tags, renderer setup, and framework-specific text rules.

output_examples.input: I want to test paste handling and escape key behavior.
output_examples.output: A test plan covering paste bytes, key events, snapshot assertions, and renderer cleanup after each test.

best_practices: Start with the framework reference before using component or pattern files.
Use renderer cleanup APIs instead of direct process exits.
Test terminal layout, focus, and keyboard behavior with realistic terminal sizes.
anti_patterns: Do not place create-tui options after the project name.
Do not assume browser DOM APIs exist in terminal renderers.
Do not skip renderer cleanup after tests or error paths.

faq.question: Does this skill support both React and Solid?
faq.answer: Yes. It includes separate references for the OpenTUI React and Solid reconcilers, plus the core imperative API.

faq.question: Can it create a complete OpenTUI application?
faq.answer: It can guide code generation and setup. You still need to install dependencies and test the project locally.

faq.question: Does it cover keyboard input?
faq.answer: Yes. It documents key events, focus, shortcuts, paste events, clipboard behavior, and related testing patterns.

faq.question: Does it include layout guidance?
faq.answer: Yes. It covers Yoga and Flexbox-style layout, absolute positioning, responsive sizing, and common layout mistakes.

faq.question: Is this only for new projects?
faq.answer: No. It also helps debug existing OpenTUI projects and review component, layout, and test patterns.

faq.question: Which runtime does OpenTUI use?
faq.answer: OpenTUI is designed for Bun and uses Zig for native builds. The references include setup and build notes.
